s.en: ): arcane backlash for 3 days; the crystal remains and can be tried again in 7 days.

s.zh: 被死亡之指杀死，又作为亡仆爬了起来。
s.en: was killed by finger of death and rose again as an undead servant.

s.zh: 的大愿望实现了，但魔网收回了许愿术：永久失去许愿术，并虚弱 10 天。
s.en: 's great wish came true, but the Weave took back the wish spell: permanently lost wish, and weakened for 10 days.

直接施放任意一个 8 环或以下的通用秘传法术（包括没学过的）。
s.en: Directly cast any general arcanum spell of circle 8 or lower (including unlearned ones).

s.zh: 本地图所有殖民者伤势全愈、疾病清除（旧伤疤不算）。
s.en: All colonists on this map are fully healed of injuries and diseases (old scars don't count).

s.zh: 变出市场价合计 3000 银以内的一种物品。
s.en: Conjure one kind of item with total market value up to 3000 silver.

s.zh: 复活 1 名死亡不超过 30 天的殖民者（没有尸体也可以）。有 33% 的概率永久失去许愿术并虚弱 10 天。
s.en: Revive 1 colonist dead for no more than 30 days (works even without a corpse). 33% chance to permanently lose wish and be weakened for 10 days.

s.zh: 施法者的一项属性永久 +1（最高 30）。有 33% 的概率永久失去许愿术并虚弱 10 天。
s.en: One of the caster's abilities +1 permanently (max 30). 33% chance to permanently lose wish and be weakened for 10 days.
Great wish: dispel a long event

s.zh: 结束本地图一个还要持续 1 天以上的事件（毒尘、寒流、火山冬天……）。有 33% 的概率永久失去许愿术并虚弱 10 天。
s.en: End one event on this map that would last more than 1 more day (toxic fallout, cold snap, volcanic winter...). 33% chance to permanently lose wish and be weakened for 10 days.

s.zh: 这个目标不行，愿望落空了。
s.en: That target won't do; the wish came to nothing.

s.zh: 选一个愿望。安全愿望没有代价；大愿望有 33% 的概率让施法者永久失去许愿术并虚弱 10 天。没选就关掉，许愿术不进冷却。
s.en: Choose a wish. Safe wishes have no cost; great wishes have a 33% chance to make the caster permanently lose wish and be weakened for 10 days. Closing without choosing means wish doesn't go on cooldown.

s.zh: 选一项（左下角「返回」回到愿望列表）。
s.en: Choose one ("back" at the bottom left returns to the wish list).
